name: Emotion
overview: Scripture teaches that managing our emotions requires wisdom and self-control, as a wise person restrains impulsive speech and feelings rather than expressing every thought (Proverbs 29:11). Believers are called to be transformed by renewing their minds, allowing them to discern God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2). Emotions are to be shared empathetically with others, rejoicing and weeping alongside them (Romans 12:15), while trusting God through prayer and thanksgiving to guard against anxiety (Philippians 4:6). Ultimately, strength to control and channel emotions rightly comes through Christ (Philippians 4:13).
